name: Repeated observations
meaning: Inventory notice; repeated people are not by themselves a split violation.

name: Within-participant target variation
meaning: Valid longitudinal possibility; baseline/stratified planning unsupported without explicit curation.

name: Within-participant domain variation
meaning: Describe crossing sites/phases; strict domain planning must assess feasibility.

name: Exact feature equality across IDs
meaning: Observed equal vectors suggest review, not verified duplicate identity.

name: Missing optional metadata
meaning: Requested checks without required metadata are not_assessable.

name: Missing protected relationship data
meaning: Strict splitting/evaluation blocked; unknown values not treated as independent.

name: Observation train/test overlap
meaning: Never waived, including diagnostic evaluation.

name: Participant train/test overlap
meaning: Violation for supported unseen-person objectives; warning under audit_only.

name: Protected-component overlap
meaning: Crossing a declared dependence component invalidates the stated independent-unit design.

name: Requested held-out domain overlaps
meaning: Only a separation violation for the corresponding unseen_site/unseen_phase objective.

name: Training class missing
meaning: Cannot fit the requested full-class baseline for that fold.

name: Test class missing
meaning: Class-complete metrics undefined for this fold; retain other meaningful results.

name: Unknown or duplicate membership
meaning: Structural membership diagnostic; reject invalid identity mapping.

name: Per-fold cohort coverage broken
meaning: No silent exclusions or automatic row intersection.

name: Inner rows escape outer train
meaning: Outer test or unknown IDs appear in an inner partition.

name: Inner partitions overlap or lack coverage
meaning: Inner training/validation identities/components and completeness must hold.

name: Complete-CV coverage unavailable
meaning: A valid one-off holdout is auditable but outside complete-CV evaluation.

name: Insufficient independent groups
meaning: Requested fold count cannot be satisfied; do not downgrade automatically.

name: Protected component crosses held-out domain
meaning: Strict domain plan rejected without removing or relabeling observations.

name: Stratification/class feasibility limitation
meaning: Document absent test-class feasibility; invalid actual training folds block plan.

name: Association review threshold crossed
meaning: Descriptive review signal, not proof of causal confounding or shortcut use.

name: Sparse contingency table
meaning: Small observed/expected counts make interpretation unstable; no p-value.

name: Association not assessable
meaning: Missing, constant, unstable or excessive-category input prevents specified statistic.

name: Upstream fitting history unknown
meaning: No automatic certification from a supplied feature matrix.

name: Declared global data-dependent fitting
meaning: User-declared information use outside training scope; not reconstructed history.

name: Declared fitting IDs violate scope
meaning: Qualified declaration-based boundary finding; does not prove historical execution.

name: Observed internal fit scope violation
meaning: Controlled runner defect; block successful evaluation and investigate.

name: Declared fixed non-learning transform
meaning: No training-fit isolation requirement solely for a fixed row-local conversion.

name: Fit failed or did not converge
meaning: Incomplete run, no complete pooled score.

name: Metric undefined
meaning: Null value plus specific reason; never substitute zero/NaN.

name: Intentionally invalid diagnostic evaluation
meaning: Do not use as evidence for unseen-participant generalization.

name: Training feature entirely missing
meaning: Document no training information and prescribed fold-local imputer handling.

name: Sensitive operational output
meaning: Identity-bearing split/private evaluation artifact; not a public report.
